messages:
Jessica: FYI opened a quick PR to fix the API reference for /v1/generate — examples still use `model` instead of `model_id` and the response example is missing the `usage` object. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:
Mike: ack, saw the linter error when I ran `make docs-validate`. I'll pick up the param rename. Question: should we mention the old `model` param for migration?
Ravinder: we shouldn't keep both in the examples. Runtime now expects `model_id`. Add a short migration note that older clients may still send `model` and we map it server-side, but docs should show canonical `model_id`.
DocsBot: lint: examples/generate.md:12 invalid type for `max_tokens` (expected integer) - also: examples/include-usage.md missing `usage` field in response schema.
Alex: also noticed the `response_format: yaml` example has `Content-Type: application/json` in the curl snippet — mismatch. Either change header or show a `text/yaml` accept header.
Tim: I'll update the curl snippet and the response example. Proposed curl (will push in PR):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model_id":"redwood-7b", "prompt":"Write a short haiku about caching.", "max_tokens":60}'
```
Tim: Updated response example will include `usage` like:```json
{
  "id": "gen_01F...",
  "object": "generation",
  "choices": [ { "text": "...", "index": 0 } ],
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 18, "total_tokens": 30 }
}
```
Jessica: :thumbsup: Please also update the Python SDK example in `docs/sdk/python/generate.md` to read `resp["usage"]["total_tokens"]` instead of `resp["token_count"]` — that field was removed in the 2025 API change. Add a one-line migration note at the top of the page.
Mike: I'll add a small doctest harness so CI validates the examples against a mocked response schema. That should catch regressions early.
Ravinder: style note — pretty-print JSON with 2-space indent in docs (keeps examples readable). Also, ensure `max_tokens` is shown as a number, not string.
Alex: pushing a small follow-up commit to align `Content-Type` for YAML examples and add an `Accept: text/yaml` example. I'll squash into the PR branch.
Jessica: thanks. Once updated I'll re-run the doc build and review.
DocsBot: PR #842: checks updated, docs build queued -> https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2331
Alex: merging after CI passes. planning to close the thread when site update is live. :rocket:
